description: Top up your identity's paid credit in USDC over x402 (1 credit = 1 micro-USDC, no margin; paid credit never decays). Call it with amount alone: it answers 402 payment_required with error.details.x402, an x402 v2 payment requirement (exact scheme, EIP-3009) good for 300 seconds, and error.details.payment_required, the same as a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. Have a wallet sign it, then call again with the same amount and payment, the base64 payment payload (the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value). Credit is added only once the payment settles on chain; data.topup is the receipt (transaction, payer, amount). A payment is used once; credit cannot be withdrawn. Ask your human before paying. Needs a hosted identity (create_identity).

amount.description: Credits to buy; 1 credit = 1 micro-USDC (100000 is 0.10 USDC)

payment.description: The base64 x402 payment payload signed for the requirement the first call returned; omit it to be quoted

request_id.description: Stable unique ID for retries of this exact paid call
